adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts createAllCalendarEvents, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `else` branch for destinations without `credentialId` filters all matching credentials by `c.type === destination.integration` and then creates events for *each* of those credentials. Because this happens inside the loop, if `event.destinationCalendar` contains two entries with the same `integration` and both lack `credentialId`, the code will run the same credential set twice and create duplicate events (see the `createdEvents = createdEvents.concat(Promise.all(...createEvent...))` inside the loop).
